content.text: CBSE Class 10 Result 2026Quick summaryIt’s time for CBSE Class 10th students to rejoice because CBSE Class 10 Results 2026 have been out today, on 15th April 2026. There must be so much excitement and anxiety amongst hundreds of thousands of students.Check CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 (Direct Link)CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 has been declared today, 15 April 2026. Students can check their results online using roll number, school number, and admit card ID on official websites like cbse.nic.in and results.cbse.nic.in. CBSE has published these result papers online on various websites and platforms for students to access. All the hard work, preparation, examinations, and anxiety come to an end, as students will get to see the results. Many schools would be talking about their performance and choosing which courses they should pursue for Class 11.Students can now check their CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 online through the official result portals. To make it easier, CBSE provides multiple platforms so students can access their marks without any delay.Use the direct link below to check your result quickly:CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 – Key HighlightsParticularsDetailsBoardCentral Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)Exam NameCBSE Class 10 Board Exam 2026 (Phase 1)Exam Dates17 February – 11 March, 2026Result Declaration Date15th April 2026 Official Websitescbse.nic.in / results.cbse.nic.inResult ModeOnline (Website, DigiLocker, SMS, IVRS)Passing Marks33% in each subjectSteps to Check CBSE 10th Result 2026 using Roll NoThe following steps need to be followed for checking the CBSE Class 10 marksheetVisit the official CBSE Result websiteSelect the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 tabEnter roll no, school no, and admit card no.Submit informationThe CBSE Class 10 marksheet 2026 will be displayed on the screenDownload and save marksheetCBSE Class 10th Result 2026: Procedure to Get Result through DigiLocker or UMANG AppThrough the easy procedure given below, students can obtain the CBSE 10th Result 2026 through DigiLocker or the UMANG app.Download the UMANG/Digilocker appLog in/Register yourself using your mobile no/Aadhar no.Type CBSE in the search bar or navigate to the Education tabSelect the CBSE board tab from thereSelect the CBSE Class 10th Result tabPut your credentials thereRetrieve your result and save itCBSE Class 10 Result Card DetailsThe CBSE result 2026 class 10 scorecard will include the following details:Name of the StudentRoll NumberFather’s and mother’s namesMarks Obtained in Each SubjectGradesTotal MarksResult Status (Pass/Compartment)Name of the SchoolStudents are suggested to check all the above-mentioned details from their CBSE result 2026 class 10 scorecard.Where to Check CBSE Class 10 Result 2026The CBSE Class 10 result out now you can use following platforms to check your CBSE Class 10 result 2026Visit Official Website - This is the main & most reliable method visit - cbse.nic.in or results.cbse.nic.inDigiLocker – Log in to the DigiLocker application or website and check out your online marksheet.SMS - Send a customized message on the CBSE result helpline number to fetch your result by SMS.IVRS - Call the CBSE IVRS helpline number and follow the voice-based prompts to fetch your results.UMANG App - The result is accessible through the UMANG Government portal as wellCBSE Class 10 Passing Marks 2026A candidate has to score at least 33% marks in each subject to pass the CBSE Class 10 exam 2026. The detailed breakdown of marks scored in each subject is provided below:Theory Examination: 80 marksInternal Assessment/Practical: 20 marksMarks of both these sections will be considered for determining passing status. On the CBSE result sheet, marks per subject, grades, as well as comments on the outcome will be published with candidate details.The declaration of the CBSE Class 10 result 2026 is a major milestone for students. While results are important, they are just the beginning of a much bigger journey ahead.Students are advised to:Download and save their scorecardsPlan their next academic step carefullyStay positive and focusedFAQ'sWhat is the CBSE Class 10 Results Release Date?CBSE 10th result has officially been announced on 15th April 2026; according to reports Visit cbse.nic.in for latest information.Where To Check CBSE 10th Class 2026 Result?Your CBSE class 10 2026 result can be accessed through these following websites: cbse.nic.in, results.cbse.nic.in, cbse.gov.in, DigiLocker, UMANG app and even by SMS/texts and automated calls.How Many Marks Should Students Score to Pass CBSE Class 10?To pass the class 10 exam students need to obtain minimum GPA of 33% marks in theoretical exam paper and at least 33% in their internal assessment (internal assessment includes attendance, project work, etc.).Explore other categoriesPersonalized Blogs, Just for youSign in to create an account for tailored recommendations based on your interest and preference
